propositions: The ownership-direction gate (check_config_ownership.py) and field-consumption gate (check_config_reads.py) scripts must execute via the portable make lint target as a single source of truth.
Both gate scripts are currently missing from make lint or running only in CI-specific workflow steps, causing double-run risk and loss of portable (no-CI-provider) execution.
The standalone Config-read gate workflow step must be removed, with its coverage migrated to the make lint target to eliminate redundancy.
CI parity tests must validate that both gate invocations are wired in the Makefile lint target and that CI runs make lint, so removal of either gate or the make lint step fails the parity check.
The test_ci_wires_the_gate test must be re-anchored from the workflow file to the Makefile lint target to track the new gate location.
